Represent the Voice of the Customer: capture and synthesize insights from implementations to inform product improvements and internal process enhancements. Elevate the team: share best practices, mentor peers, and model senior-level communication, judgment, and ownership on complex, multi-stakeholder projects. jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . Why this role, and why now Our Chief People Officer is moving on after three and a half years. They leave behind a People Experience function that works well: predictable delivery, a capable team, a high bar on senior hiring, and a seat at the table that has been earned and respected. If you want a CPO role where the function is broken and the mandate is to fix it, this isn t it. If you want one where the function is strong and the question is what a leader can do with that platform, keep reading. The uncomfortable and energising fact about working here: our customers are HR leaders. What we do internally isn’t separate from what we sell. Our own practices are watched, asked about, and sometimes bought. It’s an incredible opportunity to innovate and create the future of work. We anticipate there may be interest from current and former customers, and we welcome it! Two things worth being upfront about; applications are visible only to our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams, never to our customer-facing teams. And, being a customer earns you no advantage and no disadvantage. We ll run the same process, set the same bar, and have the same people assessing you. What you ll own The role has several dimensions. They are listed in order of weight, and we mean the order. Run People Experience (PX) well This is a critical part of the job and the thing that has to be true before anything else matters. You ll own a strong and coherent function that delivers its cycles well and on time: performance, engagement, compensation, talent acquisition, capability, compliance across four countries. No surprises to the Exec. No escalations arriving at the CEO s desk that should have been resolved two levels down. The bar we re setting: your deputies own outcomes, not tasks. Executives go to them directly and get good answers. You design the org ahead of the strategy rather than in response to it, so that when the business changes direction the structure is already close to right. Your team respects you, and your senior hires raise the average. You ll be a trusted sounding board to Caroline and the Exec on structure, senior hires, compensation and the calls that don t have clean answers. Be credible in the market and with customers Our customers are your peers. That is a commercial asset, and we want you to use it. You ll speak at our global events and in the market, join customer conversations, and support Sales and Customer Experience in rooms where a practitioner s view might land differently to a vendor s. Over time we d like Sales to be asking for you by name and customers backchannelling you for advice on their own problems. To be clear about the bar: we are not hiring a keynote speaker. You don’t need to be a world-class presenter, and polish is not what we re screening for. You need to be reliably credible on a stage and in a room, with a point of view that is specific to you rather than

jobs.title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideal
